subject: c-info
title: (R)C.INFO.------TH.CONT.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-5, second of two on book p247, paired with v2-p247-1. Continues the touring-impact argument by holding composite-information at its real register against thrust-continuance. (R)C-INFO (the reality of composite information) is crossed with TH-CONT (thrust continuance): the question is what composite-information produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with thrust-continuance — the (R) prefix marking that real composite-information (the lived music) is what the European audience encountered, distinct from theoretical or marketed accounts. TH-CONT sits at a bend in the main line; from it the line continues to MT-INFO (multi-information), which carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) above and a vertical down to VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). VT-DY carries INFO-DS (information dissemination) on the upper-right, POL-CON (political consciousness), and AFTD (affinity tendencies), from which (P)ATTN (attraction, at its point of idea completion) hangs. (R)INTR (reality of interpretation) anchors the lower-right via a *dashed* edge from INFO-DS — a dotted line that, in Braxton's legend, 'amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to'. EXT-DY (extended dynamics) hangs from the main line below the subject, and TR (transformation) hangs from EXT-DY at the lower-left.
